---
title: "RSS Climate Slides"
author: "Climate Change Response Program"
date: today
date-format: short
format:
  pptx:
    slide-level: 2
    reference-doc: "RSS-Climate-Slides-Template.pptx"
params:
  ParkCode: "ISRO"                          # Park short code
  LongName: "Isle Royale National Park"     # Full park name
  CF_selected: "WarmWet_HotDry"             # Options: "WarmWet_HotDry" or "WarmDry_HotWet"
  Base_Park_Dir: "E:/RCF_2024/RCF_opened"   # Parent directory containing park folders
  map_csv: "climate-metric-title.csv"       # CSV mapping filenames → slide titles
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

## IMPORTANT: Do not edit anything below unless you know what you are doing

## ======================================================
## Setup & Data Preparation
## ======================================================

# LIBRARIES

# install.packages(c("dplyr","readr","stringr","tools")) # Run manually (console) if these packages are not yet installed, then comment back out - Quarto rendering does not play well with this command
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tools)

# PARAMETERS

ParkCode      <- params$ParkCode
CF_selected   <- params$CF_selected
Base_Park_Dir <- params$Base_Park_Dir
MapCSV        <- params$map_csv

# DIRECTORY STRUCTURE (hard drive)

# Base_Park_Dir/
# └─ ParkCode/
#    ├─ WarmWet_HotDry/
#    │  └─ figures/
#    └─ WarmDry_HotWet/
#       └─ figures/

# Some downloads may include an extra nested ParkCode folder:
# Base_Park_Dir/ParkCode/ParkCode/WarmWet_HotDry/figures

# Failsafe for single vs double ParkCode nesting
candidate_dirs <- c(
  file.path(Base_Park_Dir, ParkCode),
  file.path(Base_Park_Dir, ParkCode, ParkCode)
)

Park_Dir <- candidate_dirs[dir.exists(candidate_dirs)][1]

if (is.na(Park_Dir) || !nzchar(Park_Dir)) {
  stop(
    "Park folder not found. Tried:\n- ",
    paste(candidate_dirs, collapse = "\n- "),
    "\n\nCheck Base_Park_Dir and ParkCode."
  )
}

CFDir <- if (CF_selected == "WarmWet_HotDry") {
  file.path(Park_Dir, "WarmWet_HotDry")
} else {
  file.path(Park_Dir, "WarmDry_HotWet")
}

FigDir <- file.path(CFDir, "figures")

if (!dir.exists(FigDir)) {
  stop(
    "Figures folder not found:\n",
    FigDir,
    "\n\nTried park folder:\n",
    Park_Dir,
    "\n\nCheck that CF_selected is correct and that the figures folder exists."
  )
}

# CLIMATE VARIABLE ORDER

variable_order <- c(
  "Temperature",
  "Precipitation",
  "Water Balance",
  "Drought",
  "Snow",
  "Relative Humidity"
)

# READ TITLE / SUBHEADING / VARIABLE MAP

# Quarto quirk - must redo order of operations for R packages
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

title_map <- read_csv(MapCSV, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    file_name           = str_trim(tolower(file_name)),
    slide_title         = str_trim(slide_title),
    slide_subheading    = str_trim(slide_subheading),
    quick_access_title  = str_trim(quick_access_title),
    common_figure       = str_trim(tolower(common_figure)),
    climate_variable    = str_trim(climate_variable),
    slide_sort          = as.numeric(slide_sort)
  )

# COLLECT FIGURES AND JOIN METADATA

fig_df <- tibble(
  file_path = list.files(
    FigDir,
    pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg|tif|tiff|gif|bmp|svg)$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    file_name = tolower(basename(file_path))
  ) %>%
  left_join(title_map, by = "file_name") %>%
  mutate(
    climate_variable = if_else(
      climate_variable %in% variable_order,
      climate_variable,
      NA_character_
    ),
    climate_sort = match(climate_variable, variable_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(climate_sort, slide_sort, file_name)
```

```{r slide-builder, include=FALSE}

## ======================================================
## Slide Builder Function
## ======================================================

make_slide <- function(row) {

  file_base <- basename(row$file_path)

  slide_title <- if (!is.na(row$slide_title) && nzchar(row$slide_title)) {
    row$slide_title
  } else {
    toTitleCase(gsub("[-_]+", " ", file_path_sans_ext(file_base)))
  }

  slide_subhead <- if (!is.na(row$slide_subheading) && nzchar(row$slide_subheading)) {
    row$slide_subheading
  } else {
    ""
  }

  img_path_clean <- gsub(
    "\\\\", "/",
    normalizePath(row$file_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  )

  cat("## ", slide_title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (slide_subhead != "") cat(slide_subhead, "\n\n")
  cat("![](", img_path_clean, "){width=10in height=7.5in}\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r generate-slides, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

## ======================================================
## Generate PowerPoint Slides
## ======================================================

# PARK TITLE SLIDE  # Can't put park name on title slide; Quarto limitation

cat("# ", params$LongName, "\n\n", sep = "")

# TABLE OF CONTENTS

cat("## Table of Contents\n\n")

for (v in variable_order) {
  anchor <- tolower(gsub(" ", "-", v))
  cat("- [", v, "](#", anchor, ")\n", sep = "")
}

cat("\n\n")

# MOST COMMON FIGURES

common_df <- fig_df %>%
  filter(common_figure == "yes")

if (nrow(common_df) > 0) {

  # Section header
  cat("# Most Common Figures\n\n")

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(common_df))) {
    make_slide(common_df[i, ])
  }
}

# FULL FIGURE SET

current_variable <- ""

for (i in seq_len(nrow(fig_df))) {

  row <- fig_df[i, ]

  this_var <- as.character(row$climate_variable)

  # Safely handle missing or uncategorized variables
  if (is.na(this_var) || this_var == "") {
    make_slide(row)
    next
  }

  # Insert section header slide when variable changes
  if (this_var != current_variable) {
    cat("# ", this_var, "\n\n", sep = "")
    current_variable <- this_var
  }

  make_slide(row)
}
```
